_meta.status: Best-effort AI-assisted translation for the SIH26003 prototype — not yet reviewed by a native speaker or community linguist. Confidence here is meaningfully lower than the other language files in this app: Kokborok has far fewer digital-text resources to draw on. Treat this as a rough first draft only, and have it corrected by a Kokborok speaker before any real deployment in Tripura.
_meta.script: Roman/Latin script, matching Tripura's officially adopted script for Kokborok since the 1970s (Bengali script is the traditional alternative).
_meta.fallback: Any key missing here falls back to English automatically (see i18n/index.ts).

common.takeBreakBody: Nwng chekhang khelakha. Chotwi arai bagwi.
common.clinicalNote: SmritiSetu-ni khela ekhali twiswm kaham hachuk laimani lama sahaiya thangdo, bar songnwi bwlwi twiswm bikhini paribortonni khoborkho lakha. Ye diagnosis kaubo. Doctor-ni kotha nono.

onboarding.chooseLanguageBody: Bini bibar swrwng thaha, honi tap thok.
onboarding.consentBody: SmritiSetu-ni khela-ni thangnai kotha pumthang — mung, khela nokha, bar unnoti — bo device-o rakha. Sync thangnai kaubo bathai bo device-o thangbo.
onboarding.consentPointStorage: Data pumthang bo device-o rakha, internet dongbo bo thangbo.
onboarding.consentPointControl: Nwng chondi Admin Panel-o data export tokhro bathai pumthang phelai jokdok.
onboarding.consentPointNotDiagnosis: SmritiSetu twiswmni khan kaham hachuk laimani lama sahaiya thangdo — ye diagnosis kaubo.
onboarding.setupCaregiverPin: Songnwi bwlwini login-ni khan 4 ankiya PIN sajai
onboarding.setupCompleteBody: SmritiSetu chondi khelani khan taiyar, internet dongbo bo thangbo.

errorBoundary.title: Chotwi bwtwr thangbai
errorBoundary.body: SmritiSetu-o bwtwr swrwngbai. Data kaubo mangbai — nwng kaham hasei sale sale lo.

caregiverAuth.title: Songnwi bwlwini login
caregiverAuth.wrongPin: Bo PIN khalam kaubo. Sale sale lo.
caregiverAuth.tooManyAttempts: Chekhang bwtwr sale. {{seconds}} second-o sale sale lo.
caregiverAuth.scanQr: Tokhro bini QR code scan thok
caregiverAuth.forgotPinBody: Bo device-o PIN recovery kaubo, tai bagwi bo screen-kho khulwi hamjani jasw-e notun PIN sidha set koro parw — bo hodai rogini khan-ko songnwi screen-ni bagwi rakhwni ekta lightweight gate thakena, asol security boundary nohoi.
caregiverAuth.forgotPinMismatch: PIN milw hwyo — arw ekbar cesta koro.

adminAuth.title: Admin login
adminAuth.wrongPin: Bo PIN khalam kaubo. Sale sale lo.

adminPanel.resetAllDataBody: Bo-e bo device-ni data pumthang chirodini phelai jokdok. Thangnani khan "{{word}}" riya.

levelSelect.title: Level tai khonai
levelSelect.body: Chotwi lock kaubo — tai level khela lai khonai jokdok. SmritiSetu chondi khelani khan swrwng khonaidok.

reminders.title: Chondi
reminders.noneToday: Chondi chotwi dongbo kaubo. Bagwi thanglaikha!
reminders.label: Ye tai bagwi?
reminders.scanFailed: Label khani parhw hwyo. Bhalo ujor thakwa photo lo, na nije type koro.

familyManager.title: Songnwi bar mukh
familyManager.body: Naam Yaad khelani khan photo, mung, bar twk-thok yathok.
familyManager.name: Mung

dashboard.title: Songnwi bwlwini dashboard
dashboard.gardenGrowthBody: Somoni sapha-o din 3 wa tarale bese khela khelile bakhwr-a ekta stage bariya jai — somoyni logot niyomito kaam naikhonai ekta shanti dinstha.
dashboard.cognitiveInsightsBody: Bibhag tai-tai-ni statistics unnoti rekha, bo khela hamjani thangnai session-o gonona thangkha — duini tulna kaubo, tokhro-ni data-tokhro tulna thangkha kaubo.
dashboard.shareWithFamilyBody: Bo link thakwa jasw-o bo somoni progress-ni read-only snapshot naikhabo parw — login lagabo. Pathabai dile ye update hwyo; notun snapshot-ni notun link bona.
dashboard.disclaimer: Bo dashboard-e doctor tokhro kotha sanani khan unnoti khobor lakha. Ye diagnosis tokhro chikitsha sara kaubo.
dashboard.noData: Data chekhang kaubo — agei chotwi khela khela.
dashboard.reminderAlertsBody: Ha, twi, tokhro kam-ni somoi thangbaidwi bo device-o sotorko naikha — SmritiSetu khula dongdwi kam thangdo, background-o bo. Bo-e chirodini bondho tab-kho khulumbai jokdok kaubo.
dashboard.reminderAlertsDenied: Anumoti bondho thangbai. Bo sarainani khan bini browser tokhro device settings-o bo site-ni khan notification sarai.

sharedView.banner: Nwng songnwi bwrwini ekjon-ni share kora read-only snapshot naikhwi thakena. Ye update hwyo, aro bo device-a caregiver hisebe sign-in kaubo.
sharedView.invalid: Bo link-a bhangi jayo nohoile bodli jayo pareloi lage. Notun ekta hudi lo.

smriti-cards.name: Smriti Cards
smriti-cards.instructions: Milkha card mainai khan duitha card-o tap thok. Tai phai tai jaiga-o dong bathai twiswm thanga.
smriti-cards.clinicalMapping: Chinha jora milaini bathai twiswm bar mung chinha (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

smriti-katha.name: Smriti Katha
smriti-katha.instructions: Chotwi kotha thangnai, tokhro chinha khonai bathai sarol proshno-ni uttor riya.
smriti-katha.clinicalMapping: Chondini kotha bathai twiswm bar kotha-twiswm (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

naam-yaad.name: Naam Yaad
naam-yaad.instructions: Nwng chinhakha manshini photo naisai. Bini khalam mung-o tap thok.
naam-yaad.clinicalMapping: Khela hamjani thangnai songnwini photo bathai twiswm bar chinha (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

dhyan-dhaam.name: Dhyan Dhaam
dhyan-dhaam.instructions: Athok-o naikha rup-ni khalam milkha tile pumthang-o tap thok.
dhyan-dhaam.clinicalMapping: Chinha twk dongnai bar cancellation kam (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

ginti-dhyan.name: Ginti Dhyan
ginti-dhyan.instructions: Sasa chotwi-o sarai bathai ank pumthang sale sale-o tap thok.
ginti-dhyan.clinicalMapping: Twk bar kam-o thangnai twiswm (MoCA) khela hamjani bathai bagwi gotini thok.

awaaz-pehchan.name: Awaaz Pehchan
awaaz-pehchan.instructions: Bagwi thok thangnai. Khalam kotha tokhro twk thangbaidwi tap thok.
awaaz-pehchan.clinicalMapping: Rai swrwng kam kaubo hamjani bathai chinha twk twiswm (MoCA) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

dinacharya-sequence.name: Dinacharya Sequence
dinacharya-sequence.instructions: Photo card-tokhro nwng chondi tai kam thangdo bo sale sale-o kaham lo.
dinacharya-sequence.clinicalMapping: Chondini kam-ni planning bar sale sale (IADL) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

bazaar-list.name: Bazaar List
bazaar-list.instructions: Bazar-ni list thangnai, tokhro grid-o bo hakhrai jinis mainai.
bazaar-list.clinicalMapping: Chondini kam-list twiswm bar planning (IADL) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

ghar-ka-kaam.name: Ghar ka Kaam
ghar-ka-kaam.instructions: Nokni sara-o tap thok, tokhro bo tai kam-ni khan bebohar thangdo bo-o tap thok.
ghar-ka-kaam.clinicalMapping: Kam bar jinis-ni jorwi (IADL) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

aakar-milan.name: Aakar Milan
aakar-milan.instructions: Rup khalam-o thangbaidok tokhro tukra mainai.
aakar-milan.clinicalMapping: Chinha-jaiga bar kam twiswm (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

chaya-khoj.name: Chaya Khoj
chaya-khoj.instructions: Jinis-o naisai, tokhro bini milkha chaya-o tap thok.
chaya-khoj.clinicalMapping: Padha thangbo kaubo chinha-jaiga milai (MoCA) tokhro jorwi dongdo.

naksha-jodo.name: Naksha Jodo
naksha-jodo.instructions: Photo sajaini khan bwrwi tukra-tokhro tokhro kaham lo. Somoi la.
naksha-jodo.clinicalMapping: Rup sajaini kam (ADAS-Cog), gudi-bora rup-ni khan chotwi jorwi.

aaj-ka-din.name: Aaj Ka Din
aaj-ka-din.instructions: Chondi bagwi chotwi sarol proshno-ni uttor riya.
aaj-ka-din.clinicalMapping: Somoi bar jaiga-ni twiswmni khan (MoCA orientation) tokhro jorwi dongdo. Bo-e chondini twk, bikhang khela kaubo.

ghadi-dekho.name: Ghadi Dekho
ghadi-dekho.instructions: Ghadi-o naisai, tokhro bo-e sabhaikha somoi-o tap thok.
ghadi-dekho.clinicalMapping: Chinha-jaiga bar somoini twiswmni khan (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) tokhro jorwi dongdo — pumthang duniya-o dementia porikha thangnani khan bebohar thangkha Clock Drawing Test-ni khalam.
